title: Animations are not smooth when activating/deactivating Plasma edit mode
line: Leaving edit mode no longer cuts the zoom-in short and makes the desktop jump to full size.
explanation: The zoomed edit mode view (blurred backdrop plus the scaled desktop) was unloaded by a fixed 200 ms timer after leaving edit mode, while the zoom-in animation is advanced per rendered frame. Whenever frames come late (two screens, a busy shell after closing the widget explorer, or slower animation settings) the view was removed mid-animation and the real desktop appeared at full size in one frame, the flicker in the report. The loader now also stays active while the zoom animation is still running.

commits.message:
Desktop edit mode: keep the zoomed view until the exit animation ends

The edit mode view was unloaded by a fixed 200 ms timer, so when frames
came late, as with two screens or slower animations, the zoom-in was cut
short and the desktop jumped to full size. Keep it while it animates.

BUG: 507169

From 963ae9949546728ca2f24105587b89ed523192d7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:08:16 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Desktop edit mode: keep the zoomed view until the exit
 animation ends

The edit mode view was unloaded by a fixed 200 ms timer, so when frames
came late, as with two screens or slower animations, the zoom-in was cut
short and the desktop jumped to full size. Keep it while it animates.

BUG: 507169
---
 desktoppackage/contents/views/Desktop.qml         | 2 +-
 desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml | 1 +
 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Desktop.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Desktop.qml
index 1be09364ef..d5cd1ee0fe 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Desktop.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Desktop.qml
@@ -117,7 +117,7 @@ Item {
         id: editModeLoader
         anchors.fill: parent
         sourceComponent: DesktopEditMode {}
-        active: root.containment?.plasmoid.corona.editMode || editModeUiTimer.running
+        active: root.containment?.plasmoid.corona.editMode || editModeUiTimer.running || (item?.animating ?? false)
         Timer {
             id: editModeUiTimer
             property bool editMode: root.containment?.plasmoid.corona.editMode ?? false
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml
index fd643d976f..7f873da860 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml
@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@ Item {
     property real centerY: Math.round(editModeUi.y + editModeUi.height/2)
     property real roundedRootWidth: Math.round(root.width)
     property real roundedRootHeight: Math.round(root.height)
+    readonly property bool animating: xAnim.running
 
     property bool open: false
     Component.onCompleted: {
--

media.caption: Exit edit mode with the widget explorer open (two screens, animations at 3x): the zoomed view is removed at 827 of 1280 px and the desktop jumps to full size
Same steps with the fix: the zoom-in runs to 1279 px before the view is removed

review.text: Keeping the edit-mode Loader active while the zoom-in animation runs prevents the hardcoded 200 ms timer from cutting off slower or delayed exit animations, but the fix is explicitly incomplete while closing the bug with BUG: 507169. The report and comment 2 center on laggy animation when opening edit mode with the Widget Explorer, which the author notes still blocks the GUI thread for ~340 ms and is left unaddressed. In addition, retaining the hardcoded 200 ms editModeUiTimer alongside only xAnim.running leaves a regression for fast or disabled animations where editModeUi hides while the blurred backdrop lingers until 200 ms elapses, and the before/after evidence had to use a 3x animation speed factor to reproduce a major cut-off.
changes: Address the opening edit-mode / Widget Explorer stutter reported in the bug (e.g., deferring or decoupling heavy WidgetExplorer model initialization and sidebar instantiation from the zoom-out animation) rather than leaving it unfixed while closing BUG: 507169.

Replace or fix the hardcoded 200 ms editModeUiTimer in Desktop.qml and check all relevant zoom animations (not just xAnim.running) so fast or disabled animations (longDuration < 200 ms) do not leave the blurred DesktopEditMode backdrop visible after editModeUi hides.
Verify both opening and closing edit mode with the Widget Explorer at default 1x animation speed on two screens and provide evidence of smooth animations without the 3x animation-factor workaround.

reviews.text: Keeping the edit-mode Loader active while xAnim runs is a correct, small fix for the fixed 200 ms timer that doesn't follow the animation duration. But it only covers part of the bug. The report's step 1, the laggy animation when entering edit mode through 'Add or Manage Widgets' (Marco's c2: widget explorer and delegates instantiated during the animation), is explicitly left unaddressed in the notes, yet the commit says BUG: 507169. The evidence also only shows a difference at 3x animation speed: at the default 1x the layer was already removed on the last frame on master, so the flicker Tracey saw at normal speed with two screens isn't shown to be fixed by this change.
changes: Also fix the entering stutter: create or load the WidgetExplorer model ahead of time or off the GUI thread, or delay showing the sidebar until the zoom-out finishes, so 'Add or Manage Widgets' animates smoothly. Otherwise change this commit to CCBUG.
Reproduce the exit flicker at the default animation speed with two screens (the reporter's setup) and show it is gone, or identify what else causes it at 1x.
